$comment: Generated by `jx schema` from project.json#/extensions — do not edit.

anyOf.description: Explicit value list: generates one page per value, bound to `param` (default "value").
JSON data-file source: loads a project-relative file that must contain an array, and generates one page per item.

$ref.description: Project-relative path to a .json file containing an array.

field.description: Item field providing the parameter value (default "id").

anyOf.description: Legacy explicit form: an array of ready-made parameter objects, used as-is with no expansion. Prefer one of the source shapes above.

DefsMap.description: Map of reusable JSON Schema type definitions. Keys are PascalCase type names. No runtime artifacts are produced.

TypeDefEntry.description: A $defs type definition entry. Must be a pure JSON Schema type definition or a class definition (.class.json format).

StateMap.description: Map of runtime variables. Keys are camelCase (public) or #-prefixed (private). All entries are reactive by default.

StateEntry.description: A single state entry. Shape is determined by value type: scalar/array → naked reactive property, string with ${} → computed, object with $prototype: "Function" → function, object with $prototype: <other> → data source, object with type and default → typed reactive property, plain object → naked object reactive property.

TypedStateDef.description: A typed reactive state variable with explicit type and default value. The type property is a JSON Schema or $ref to a $defs type definition. The default property is the initial runtime value.

$ref.description: Reference to a shared type definition.

attribute.description: Linked HTML attribute name for CEM extraction.

reflects.description: Whether property changes reflect back to the HTML attribute.

type.description: JSON Schema type definition, $ref to a $defs type, or JSON Schema type string.

PureTypeDef.description: A reusable JSON Schema type definition for tooling only. No function, no runtime artifact. Referenced from state entries via $ref. Naming convention: PascalCase.

FunctionDef.description: A function declaration. $prototype must be "Function". body (inline) and $src (external) are mutually exclusive. First parameter is always state (the reactive scope).

$export.description: Named export in $src module. Defaults to the state key name.

$lazy.description: Load $src on first call instead of importing it up front. The function then returns a promise, so it may only be called from a handler or lifecycle hook — never bound as a computed value. Use it for code most visitors never reach.

$src.description: External module specifier. Mutually exclusive with body.

arguments.description: Legacy alias for parameters: bare string parameter names (state may be listed explicitly as the first name). Superseded by parameters.

body.description: Inline function body: an opaque JS source string (first implicit parameter is state), or a structured statement array (spec §20) — explicit structured function declaration, analyzable by tooling and editable visually. The escalation ladder within the shape is structured statements → JS string.
examples: state.items.push({ id: Date.now(), text: "", done: false })

emits.description: Array of CEM-compatible Event objects this function dispatches. Used for CEM extraction and studio event discovery.

name.description: Explicit function name. Defaults to the state key name.

parameters.description: Function parameters (after the implicit state parameter). Accepts CEM-compatible parameter objects or bare string names for backward compatibility.

type.description: Return type for tooling (JSON Schema or CEM { text } format).

ClassDef.description: A .class.json schema-defined class. $prototype must be "Class". Defines fields, constructor, methods, and type parameters via $defs. Optionally points to a JS module via $implementation for hybrid execution.

$defs.description: Class members: parameters, returnTypes, fields, constructor, methods.

fields.description: Class fields with role, access, scope, and type information.

parameters.description: Reusable typed parameter schemas, keyed by name.

returnTypes.description: Output type schemas, keyed by name.

$implementation.description: Relative path to a JS module containing the actual class implementation.

extends.description: Base class — string name or $ref to another .class.json.

title.description: PascalCase class name, used as the export name.

ClassParameterDef.description: A typed parameter definition for a class.

format.description: When "json-schema", this parameter's value is itself a JSON Schema.

ClassFieldDef.description: A class field definition with access control and scope.

$prototype.description: Data source prototype for this field (e.g., "Request").

ClassMethodDef.description: A class method or accessor definition. Capability roles (parse, serialize, rewrite, discover, load) mark static methods that hosts (compiler, server, studio) invoke for format dispatch.

timing.description: Execution environments allowed to call this capability directly. Hosts outside the list round-trip through the dev server.

FormatDef.description: Format participation marker. A class carrying this block is auto-discovered from the project imports map and used for file-extension dispatch by the compiler, server, and studio.

documentKinds.description: "page"/"component" allow the extension in pages/components discovery; "content" allows it as a content-type source.

exportTarget.description: When true, site builds emit a serialized sidecar per page in this format.

extensions.description: File extensions this format claims, with leading dot (e.g. [".md"]).

mediaType.description: MIME type for the format (icons, labels, HTTP).

remote.description: When true, the load capability accepts http(s) URLs as sources.

ProjectBlockDef.description: Project-section admission block (specs/extensions.md §9). A class carrying this block owns the project.json section named by `key`; hosts dispatch that section's data through the class's projectData/resolvePaths capabilities.

key.description: The project.json top-level section this class owns (exclusive per project).

referenceable.description: Whether section entries can be referenced from documents (e.g. content types).

ServerBlockDef.description: Server-mount admission block (specs/extensions.md §11). A class carrying this block mounts routes under its /_jx/ basePath in the site worker and dev server.

basePath.description: Route subtree this class mounts — must be under /_jx/ (exclusive per project).

module.description: Module specifier exporting the mount handler.

ConnectorBlockDef.description: Connection-provider admission block (specs/extensions.md §12). A class carrying this block provides database connections of the given provider/kind.

kind.description: SQL dialect family the provider speaks.

local.description: Local-development substitute provider (e.g. sqlite for D1).

module.description: Module specifier exporting the provider implementation.

serve.description: Module specifier exporting the serve-time worker binding.

StudioHints.description: Studio control-surface hints for a format class: editor modes, document-mode rules, templates, and the element/nesting constraints that gate structural editing.

componentWhen.description: Treat the document as a component when this top-level/frontmatter key matches the regex.

elements.description: Element allowlist and nesting constraints for structural editing.

nesting.description: Per-parent child rules keyed by tag (or "_root"): { block, inline, directive } booleans or { only: [tags] }.

modes.description: Editor modes the studio offers for documents of this format.

newFileTemplate.description: Initial source text for newly created files of this format.

ExternalClassDef.description: An external class / data source. $prototype is a constructor name (not "Function"). When $prototype is not in the built-in registry, $src is required. All state entries are reactive by default.

$export.description: Named export in $src module. Defaults to the $prototype value.

$prototype.description: Constructor name — built-in Web API class or external class name.

$src.description: External module specifier. Required when $prototype is not a built-in.

anyOf.description: A single filter object, e.g. an equality shorthand.
Ordered filter rules, e.g. [{ field: "Slug", op: "not empty" }].

filter.description: Filter configuration: a reactive $ref binding, a single filter object, or an ordered array of rules.

anyOf.description: A single sort rule, e.g. { field, order }.
Ordered sort rules, e.g. [{ field: "date", order: "desc" }].

sort.description: Sort configuration: a reactive $ref binding, a single { field, order } rule, or an ordered array of rules.

src.description: Configuration property passed to external class constructor.

ExpressionPointer.description: A JSON Pointer $ref operand within an expression node. $args/<name> resolves a named formula's parameter (callable entries only).

anyOf.description: Plain-object literal (e.g. an Intl options bag). Objects carrying $ref or operator keys are pointers/nodes, never literals.

ExpressionLiteral.description: A non-reactive operand: scalar, plain-object literal, or array of operands.

ExpressionOperand.description: Anything that may appear in target or value: a pointer, a literal, or a nested expression node.

PureMethod.description: A genuine pure String.prototype / Array.prototype / Number.prototype method (spec §19.4d). The ES2023 change-by-copy family (toSorted, toReversed, toSpliced, with) stands in where mutation would otherwise occur. Receiver in target; value carries the argument (bare scalar) or argument list (array).

ExpressionNode.description: The core expression node. operator + target, with value gated by arity.

oneOf.title: Binary — left in target, right in value
pop / shift — array receiver, no value
push / unshift — array receiver, single value argument
reduce — pure fold over a pointer or derived array; seed in initial
map / filter — pure over a pointer or derived array; per-item expression in value

oneOf.description: The ECMAScript conditional (ternary) operator, pure: target is the test, value the consequent, initial the alternate (the reduce precedent for repurposing initial). Chain else-if by nesting another ?: node in initial.
oneOf.title: ?: — pure conditional; test in target, consequent in value, alternate in initial

oneOf.description: Value-keyed multiway selection, pure: target is the discriminant (matched against case keys by its string form, like element-level $switch), cases maps matched values to result operands, default is the operand when no case matches (result is undefined without it). Condition-chain branching composes from nested ?: nodes instead.
oneOf.title: switch — pure value-keyed selection; discriminant in target, results in cases/default

oneOf.description: A pure standard-library method call: target is the receiver (any operand — never mutated; change-by-copy names replace the mutating originals), value the optional argument (bare scalar) or argument list (array). A missing receiver or method yields undefined, matching null-safe path reads.
oneOf.title: Pure method — genuine prototype methods; receiver in target, args in value

oneOf.description: Invoke a callable, pure in formula position: target is the callee pointer — a named formula entry (#/state/…) or a blessed pure global via window#/ (Math.*, JSON.*, Object.keys/values/entries, and the Intl helpers Intl/formatNumber, Intl/formatDate, Intl/formatRelativeTime, Intl/formatList, Intl/plural, Intl/compare, Intl/displayName, Intl/segment) — and value is the positional argument list (the splice args-in-value precedent). Argument order follows the callee's declared parameters.
oneOf.title: call — invoke a named formula or blessed global; callee in target, args in value

cases.description: switch only: matched discriminant value (string form) → result operand.

default.description: switch only: result operand when no case key matches.

ExpressionEntry.description: A declarative expression entry (Shape 5). Used as a state entry or inline event handler. With parameters it is a named formula: a pure, reusable computation invoked via the call operator, its parameters resolved through $args/<name> refs in the body.

parameters.description: Named-formula parameters (CEM convention, as on Function entries): bare names or CEM parameter objects. Present ⇒ the entry is callable, not a computed value.

Statement.description: One statement of a structured function body. Either a bare expression node in statement position (a mutation like =/push, or a call — its result discarded unless captured by an assignment), an if/then/else branch (JSON Schema conditional keywords; if holds a pure expression, then/else hold statement lists), a $switch multiway branch (discriminant matched by string form against cases keys, like element-level $switch), a dispatchEvent statement (WHATWG DOM: dispatches a CustomEvent from the handler's current target, with CustomEventInit members detail/bubbles/composed), or the two WHATWG event verbs stopPropagation and preventDefault, each spelled as the member set to true.

oneOf.title: if / then / else — conditional branch (JSON Schema keyword triple)
$switch / cases — multiway branch (element-level convention, ECMA switch semantics)

dispatchEvent.description: The CustomEvent type to dispatch (WHATWG DOM dispatchEvent).

oneOf.title: dispatchEvent — emit a CustomEvent (WHATWG naming, CustomEventInit members)

stopPropagation.description: Stop the handler's event at the current target (WHATWG DOM stopPropagation), so an ancestor's handler for the same event does not run. A body run without an event has nothing to stop.

oneOf.title: stopPropagation — stop the event here (WHATWG DOM)

preventDefault.description: Cancel the handler's event's default action (WHATWG DOM preventDefault): a link's navigation, a form's submission, a key's scroll.

oneOf.title: preventDefault — cancel the event's default action (WHATWG DOM)

StatementList.description: A structured function body: statements executed sequentially (one yielding a promise is awaited before the next, per ECMA async/await semantics).

ElementDef.description: A Jx element definition. Maps directly to a DOM element.

cases.description: Switch cases for this element. Maps case values to element definitions or external component refs, rendered according to the reactive $switch discriminant.

ChildrenValue.description: Array of child definitions — elements, text, or Array namespaces (dynamic lists) mixed freely. A bare Array namespace (the whole children slot is one dynamic list) is also accepted for backward compatibility, as is a ${…} template string that resolves at build time to an array of child definitions.

oneOf.description: Computed children — a ${…} template that resolves at build time to an array of child definitions (e.g. "${state.entry.$children}" for parsed content). A bare plain-text string is NOT a valid children value; text children must be array items.

ArrayNamespace.description: Dynamic mapped list. Re-renders when the items state entry changes.

key.description: The identity of each rendered row: a $map/item pointer read per item. A row whose key survives a change keeps its DOM node and its effects across reorders, insertions and removals; without a key, rows are keyed by index. $map/index is not a key — an index names a position, not a row.

SwitchDef.description: Reactive $ref that drives which case to render: a state entry, or inside a mapped array's template the row's $map/item or $map/index (spec §14.1).

StyleObject.description: CSS style definition. camelCase property names follow CSSOM convention. Keys starting with :, ., &, or [ are treated as nested CSS selectors. Keys matching $media breakpoint names (or other @-prefixed at-rules) group nested rules. Nesting is recursive: selector and at-rule groups may nest to arbitrary depth (e.g. breakpoint → selector → pseudo-class), mirroring the compiler's recursive emission. An object carrying $ref is a reactive VALUE, and the runtime reads it as one. It also matches the nested-block branch vacuously, since a block admits a string under any key, which is why these branches are anyOf rather than oneOf. A DECLARATION at-rule (@font-face, @property, @position-try, @counter-style) may hold an ARRAY of blocks, which is that key written more than once, in order: an object's keys are unique, so @font-face — the at-rule whose identity is not in its key — could not otherwise state a family's second weight at all.

$description.description: Why this rule exists. Emitted as a comment by static builds, ignored at runtime.

AttributesObject.description: HTML attributes and ARIA attributes set via element.setAttribute().

PropsObject.description: Explicit prop passing at a component boundary.

RefObject.description: A $ref binding. Resolves to a state entry (reactive) or plain value (static).

InternalRef.description: Reference to a $defs type definition in the current component.

StateRef.description: Reference to a state entry (runtime variable) in the current component.

ExternalRef.description: Reference to an external Jx component file.

GlobalRef.description: Reference to a window or document global.

ParentRef.description: Reference to a named state entry passed via $props from a parent component.

MapRef.description: Reference to the current Array map iteration context.

CemParameter.description: A CEM-compatible parameter definition for a function. Follows the Custom Elements Manifest Parameter shape.

type.description: Parameter type (JSON Schema or CEM { text } format).

CemEvent.description: A CEM-compatible event definition. Describes a CustomEvent the function dispatches.

TagName.description: HTML element tag name or custom element name (must contain a hyphen per Web Components spec). A NAME, never an expression: no `${…}` position in the pipeline evaluates a tagName. Use `$switch`/`cases` to vary the element.

anyOf.description: Two-way: `target` is the test, `value` the tag when it is truthy, `initial` the tag when it is not.
anyOf.title: ?: — the tag when the test holds, and the tag when it does not

anyOf.description: Multiway: `target` is the discriminant, matched against case keys by its string form. `default` is required — an element with no tag cannot exist.
anyOf.title: switch — one tag per discriminant value, with a required fallback

TagExpression.description: A tag name chosen at element creation. Every branch resolves to a `TagName`, so the candidate set is enumerable without evaluating anything.

HeadEntry.description: A page-level <head> entry. Defines meta tags, link tags, script tags, etc.

textContent.description: Element content. An object is serialized to JSON inside the tag — that is how a JSON-LD block (`<script type="application/ld+json">`) is authored.

ImageConfig.description: Image optimization configuration for the project.

picture.description: Wrap a multi-format image in a with one per format (default true). With it off the carries a srcset in the preferred format alone, which browsers that cannot decode that format will still select from.

remoteDomains.description: Hostnames whose remote (https) images are optimized through /cdn-cgi/image transform URLs (cloudflare service only), e.g. ["drive.usercontent.google.com"]. Remote sources from other hosts are left untouched.

service.description: How images are optimized: "build" runs Sharp at build time; "cloudflare" emits /cdn-cgi/image transform URLs served by Cloudflare Image Transformations (requires the feature to be enabled on the serving zone).

anyOf.description: Explicit value list: generates one page per value, bound to `param` (default "value").
JSON data-file source: loads a project-relative file that must contain an array, and generates one page per item.

$ref.description: Project-relative path to a .json file containing an array.

field.description: Item field providing the parameter value (default "id").

anyOf.description: Legacy explicit form: an array of ready-made parameter objects, used as-is with no expansion. Prefer one of the source shapes above.

A source shape contributed by an extension this schema cannot see. The project's generated document.schema.json validates these exactly; enable the owning extension and regenerate with `jx schema` to get precise checking here.

PathsValue.description: Default $paths source union: the core shapes, plus a catch-all for source shapes contributed by extensions this schema cannot see. The project's generated document.schema.json replaces this with the exact set its extensions provide.

v1.description: Schema for Jx component files. A Jx document is a JSON object that declaratively describes a reactive web component: its structure (DOM tree), styling, type definitions ($defs), runtime state, and inline or external functions. Reactivity is powered by @vue/reactivity.

$defs.description: Pure JSON Schema type definitions for this component. All entries are reusable type schemas — no runtime artifacts are produced. Referenced from state entries via $ref. Naming convention: PascalCase.

$elements.description: Custom element dependencies. Items are either $ref objects pointing to JX element definitions, or bare npm package name strings for web component libraries.

oneOf.description: npm package specifier (must declare customElements in package.json)

$head.description: Page-level <head> entries. Array of head entries for meta tags, link tags, script tags, etc. Merged with layout and site-level $head entries.

$id.description: Component identifier string. Used by tooling and the builder.

$dir.description: Base direction for this page's <html> element, overriding `defaults.dir`. Right-to-left content renders left-to-right without it.

$lang.description: Language tag for this page's <html> element, overriding `defaults.lang` (site-architecture.md §8.4).

$translationKey.description: This page's identity across languages, overriding the one its path implies (site-architecture.md §13.5). Two routes are translations when their keys match; the default key is the path with the locale prefix removed, which is right whenever the paths are parallel and wrong for a localized slug — /fr-ca/a-propos/ shares nothing with /about/ until one of them says so.

$layout.description: Layout reference for pages. String path to a layout JSON file, or false to opt out of the default layout.

$shadow.description: Render this component into a shadow root instead of the light DOM (spec.md §16.6). Off unless set: a shadow root isolates the component's styles from the page and replaces the <slot> emulation with real slot distribution, so it changes how the component composes. Overrides `defaults.shadow` in both directions — `false` opts one component out of a project that opted in.

$sitemap.description: Set false to exclude this page from sitemap.xml (site-architecture.md §8.4.1). Every other page with a URL is included.

$media.description: Named media breakpoints following CSS @custom-media convention. Keys use the CSS custom property -- prefix. Pure color-scheme queries (e.g. "--dark": "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") are dual-emitted so a data-color-scheme attribute on the root element forces the scheme regardless of the OS preference (spec §9.5).

$paths.description: Dynamic route source for a page: expands one page per entry at build time. One of the core shapes (explicit `values`, a `$ref` data file, or a bare array of parameter objects) or a source shape contributed by an enabled extension, such as the parser's `contentType`.

$schema.description: URI identifying the Jx dialect version. Enables schema-aware IDE tooling.

cases.description: Switch cases object. Maps case values to element definitions or external component refs. Used alongside $switch for dynamic component rendering.

imports.description: Import map: $prototype names to .class.json file paths. Allows state entries to reference external classes by name without $src.

observedAttributes.description: HTML attributes the custom element watches for changes. Follows the Web Components observedAttributes convention.

state.description: Runtime variables for this component. All entries are reactive by default. Entry shape is determined by value type: scalar/array → reactive property, string with ${} → computed, object with $prototype → function or data source, object with type and default → typed reactive property.

title.description: Page title. Can be a static string or a template string with ${} expressions.

v1.title: Jx Document

ext-parser-document-v1.title: Parser document fragment
ext-parser-document-v1.description: Document-schema fragment contributed by @jxsuite/parser: the content-type `$paths` source shape unioned into the document paths resource.

ContentPathsSource.description: Content-type $paths source: expands a dynamic route from the entries of a loaded content type.

contentType.description: Name of the content type (a key of the project.json `content` section).

param.description: Route parameter to fill from each entry (default "slug").

field.description: Entry field providing the parameter value; "id" (the default) uses the entry id.
